from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c5a936fe.py')

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three-color marker is a horizontal sequence along the top edge.
    row0 = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3)
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[row0]) if v]
    colors = [grid[row0][c] for c in cols]
    left_col, middle_col, right_col = cols[0], cols[1], cols[2]
    left_color, middle_color, right_color = colors
    # The center color is a full vertical guide.
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][middle_col] = middle_color
    # The outer colors make L-shaped guides from the top marker to their matching singleton.
    for color, start_col in ((left_color, left_col), (right_color, right_col)):
        points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
                  if v == color and (r, c) != (row0, start_col)]
        if points:
            r, c = points[0]
            for rr in range(min(row0, r), max(row0, r) + 1):
                out[rr][start_col] = color
            for cc in range(min(start_col, c), max(start_col, c) + 1):
                out[r][cc] = color
    return out
'''
